SolveSpace NG in a browser

SolveSpace NG is a personal fork of SolveSpace, the parametric 2D/3D CAD tool. It is built for my own use and may change or break at any time.

SolveSpace NG

The new interface: floating panels, command palette (Space), pie menus and a keyboard-first keymap. Without the Open CASCADE features (fillets, shells, holes, STEP), which the desktop version has.

Classic interface

The same core with SolveSpace's own web interface: its toolbar and text window.

Both run entirely in your browser and need WebGL 2. Source, known problems and the desktop version: github.com/chalkwalk/solvespace-ng.
